title: Connect Shopify.
excerpt: Connect a Shopify store so FeedOps can start importing product data.
author: FeedOps
content:
Use this checklist when connecting Shopify to FeedOps.

## Before you start

- Confirm you have admin access to the Shopify store.
- Make sure product, inventory and collection permissions are available.
- Keep your FeedOps workspace open in another tab.

## Connect the store

- Open Connections in FeedOps.
- Choose Shopify.
- Approve the requested store permissions.
- Return to FeedOps and start the first product import.

## After connection

Check that products, variants, prices and availability are importing as expected.
